title: FlipJev: Fast Black-Box Red Teaming Finds Universal Adversarial Suffixes for Typed Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.38895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Typed decision models are an emerging class of language models that make decisions instead of generating free-text responses. They answer in a single fast and cheap query and are increasingly used, including in security-sensitive tasks. However, red teaming of these models leaves two gaps: existing adaptive attacks do not use their speed, and few studies have searched for universal adversarial examples. We fill both gaps on Jev, the representative typed decision model, with a quick black-box query-based attack that calls no attacker language model. We conduct extensive experiments on 12 datasets with different data types and application scenarios. The results show that Jev resists common prompt injections: no strategy changes a correct answer in 10,240 paired tests. In contrast, our attack finds short suffixes that flip confident answers within minutes. These suffixes are universal: one suffix per dataset flips 43% of unseen documents.

translated_title: FlipJev：快速黑盒红队测试为类型化决策模型发现通用对抗后缀
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型是一类新兴的语言模型，它们做出决策而非生成自由文本回复。这类模型通过单次快速且低成本的查询即可作答，应用日益广泛，包括在安全敏感任务中。然而，此类模型的红队测试存在两个空白：现有的自适应攻击未能利用其速度优势，且很少有研究搜索过通用对抗样本。我们在代表性的类型化决策模型 Jev 上填补了这两个空白，提出了一种快速的黑盒查询式攻击，该攻击无需调用攻击者语言模型。我们在 12 个涵盖不同数据类型和应用场景的数据集上开展了大量实验。结果表明，Jev 能够抵抗常见的提示注入攻击：在 10,240 次配对测试中，没有任何策略能改变其正确答案。相比之下，我们的攻击能在几分钟内找到可翻转高置信度答案的短后缀。这些后缀具有通用性：每个数据集仅需一个后缀即可翻转 43% 的未见文档。
tldr: 本文提出 FlipJev——一种无需攻击者语言模型的快速黑盒查询式攻击，可在几分钟内发现通用对抗后缀，成功翻转代表性类型化决策模型 Jev 的高置信度答案，填补了此类模型红队测试的两大空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FlipJev, a fast black-box query-based attack requiring no attacker language model, which finds universal adversarial suffixes within minutes that flip confident answers of the representative typed decision model Jev, with a single suffix per dataset flipping 43% of unseen documents.
